This framework creates essential grid headroom by optimizing existing transmission and distribution capacity, and can be deployed in months, offering a significantly faster alternative to building traditional large-scale power facilities. title: DeepSeek's DSpark Makes Nvidia's LPX Decode Rack a Tougher Sell
brief_text: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark speculative decoding module is making it harder for Nvidia to sell its new Groq 3 LPX decode rack as a required upgrade for agentic AI workloads. title: AI chip demand drives console prices to unprecedented highs
brief_text: Surging demand for semiconductors and memory from the AI industry is pushing games console prices to record levels, with Sony and Microsoft recently raising prices on their current-generation hardware. Analysts say a deal between OpenAI and chipmakers Samsung and SK Hynix for datacentre DRAM caused memory prices to nearly double, and they have since doubled again according to Xbox. With memory supply controlled by just three major companies and new factory capacity not expected until 2028, Lenovo's executive director has suggested prices may never return to previous lows. The price hikes have hit sales hard, with US hardware sales hitting 30-year lows last November and the average new hardware price reaching an all-time high of $502 last month, while PS5 sales fell 58% year-on-year. Looking ahead, analysts predict the PlayStation 6 could retail at $1,000 or more, and industry figures are questioning whether traditional console cycles can survive, with cloud gaming and hybrid devices seen as potential alternatives.

title: DeepSeek's DSpark Makes Nvidia's LPX Decode Rack a Tougher Sell
brief_text: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark speculative decoding module is making it harder for Nvidia to sell its new Groq 3 LPX decode rack as a required upgrade for agentic AI workloads. DSpark, released under an MIT license, boosts per-user generation speed by 60% to 85% on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and 57% to 78% on V4-Pro by reducing the number of full decode passes needed per output. Combined with DeepSeek's MLA architecture, which cuts KV cache memory requirements by over 90%, these software innovations directly shrink the decode bottleneck that LPX is designed to monetize. Nvidia's LPX rack, built around 256 Groq LPU accelerators and paired with Vera Rubin GPUs, requires a separate purchase decision from customers who have already committed to Rubin systems. The bear case is that DSpark running on general Rubin GPUs alone may deliver enough inference efficiency to make LPX optional for most workloads, especially as hyperscalers like AWS and Cerebras launch competing disaggregated inference solutions on the same 2026 timeline.
reason: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark module boosts inference speed and reduces decode bottlenecks, strengthening its competitive position.

title: FireFly Metals reports exceptional high-grade drill results at Green Bay, extending core zone
brief_text: FireFly Metals has announced exceptional drilling results that extend the high-grade core zone and confirm strong continuity of mineralization at its Green Bay Copper-Gold Project in Canada. Infill drilling of the over 800-meter-long core zone returned thick intersections including 42.0 meters at 6.1% copper equivalent and 51.5 meters at 4.9% copper equivalent, with a high-grade VMS sub-interval of 9.8 meters at 16.5% copper equivalent. title: Real Intent Meridian CDC with Microarchitectural Analysis Cuts Sign-Off Review Burden by 95 Percent
brief_text: Real Intent announced Meridian CDC with Microarchitectural Analysis, a major advance for its clock domain crossing static sign-off tool that reduces the designer CDC sign-off review burden by 95 percent. brief_text: SpaceX、Anthropic、OpenAIといった大型IPOが相次ぐ中、市場全体の40%暴落を懸念する声があるが、データはその可能性が低いことを示している。SpaceXは米国史上最大のIPOで750億ドルを調達し、評価額は1.75兆ドルに達した。Anthropicは300億ドルの調達を目指して極秘にIPOを申請し、評価額は約9650億ドルとされる。OpenAIも来年のIPOが見込まれている。これら3件のIPOによる調達総額は約2000億ドルで、米国の投資可能な株式資本の約0.4%に過ぎず、市場ストラテジストのエド・ヤルデニは「管理可能」な規模と指摘する。しかし、資金調達の影響は市場全体ではなく、既存のAI・テクノロジー株からの資金移動という形で現れる可能性が高い。ファンドマネージャーは新規ポジションのために既存の類似銘柄を売却するため、Nvidia、AMD、その他AIインフラ銘柄に売り圧力がかかるとみられる。実際、SpaceXのIPO前週にはナスダックが4.18%下落し、ヘッジファンドが半導体株やAIインフラ株を売却したことが要因とされる。AnthropicとOpenAIのIPOが続けば、同様のローテーションが再び起こり、AIインフラ支出の持続性への疑念が強まる可能性もある。また、ナスダックは5月にルールを改正し、大型IPOが上場後15日以内にナスダック100に組み入れられるようになったため、QQQ ETFに連動するパッシブ運用の買い需要が生じる一方、既存構成銘柄の売却を促す。過去の40%超の暴落はいずれもレバレッジ投資家の強制売却が連鎖したもので、IPOの集中が直接の原因ではない。ドットコムバブルとの比較でも、市場のピークはIPOパイプラインの過熱より前に訪れており、バリュエーション問題が先行していた。したがって、最も現実的なリスクは市場全体の流動性ではなく、NvidiaやAMDなど特定のAI銘柄への集中したバリュエーション圧力である。

title: Anthropic's Export Controls on AI Models Lifted by US Commerce Department
brief_text: The US Commerce Department has lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models, potentially reopening wider access after the startup worked through the Trump administration's safety concerns. Anthropic said Fable 5 access will begin returning globally on Wednesday across its own platforms, with usage through Amazon, Microsoft, and Alphabet cloud services expected to follow as quickly as possible. The company is also redeploying Fable 5 with new classifiers aimed at blocking more cybersecurity tasks, while Mythos 5 access has already been restored for some US organizations tied to Project Glasswing. The reversal could ease pressure across the AI sector after the restrictions raised questions over whether export controls may become a tool for regulating frontier model access. title: US private credit market recalibrates in Q2 2026 as software falls from favor
brief_text: The US private credit market underwent a significant recalibration in the second quarter of 2026, with lenders and investors reassessing exposure to software and other once-favored sectors amid geopolitical turmoil and AI-driven disruption. Direct lending deal volume fell sharply to $29.2 billion across 138 transactions through June 22, well below the $74.1 billion across 217 deals in the first quarter, according to LCD data. The war in Iran and the release of Anthropic's Claude Cowork, which fueled a global sell-off of software and IT companies, compounded existing negativity and stymied M&A and buyout activity. Healthcare surpassed technology as the largest sector by new deal count, while lenders demanded pristine metrics from software borrowers, with Vista Credit Partners estimating that about 20% of software businesses are in a 'failure to thrive' category. Despite the slowdown, pricing improved for lenders, with spreads widening roughly 25 to 50 basis points, and Apollo and Blackstone led a $36 billion investment-grade structured notes financing for AI giant Anthropic, though it was excluded from direct lending volume due to its structure. Redemption pressures intensified at non-traded BDCs, with Blackstone Private Credit Fund's redemption demand climbing to 10% in Q2, while the nascent secondary market for private credit loans saw a pickup in activity, with JPMorgan trading roughly $2 billion worth of loans as of mid-May.

title: AI Infrastructure Buildout Shifts Focus to Energy as Scarce Resource
brief_text: Trillions of dollars are being poured into AI factories, but the scarcest resource is energy, not chips or models. McKinsey estimates AI-related infrastructure spending could exceed $5 trillion by 2030, while JLL projects developers may require roughly 100 gigawatts of new data-center capacity over the same period. Utilities face multi-year waits for grid connections, forcing companies like Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to secure dedicated power. Bitzero, which controls a development pipeline exceeding one gigawatt of potential capacity across Norway, Finland, and North Dakota, announced a binding letter with OneQode Networks for a 15-year lease on the full 110 megawatts of its Namsskogan campus, valued at approximately $2.6 billion. Kevin O'Leary, a key backer, said he considers Bitzero a real estate power company with sub-six cents per kilowatt-hour power, land, permits, and water, adding that perhaps 50 percent or more of announced U.S. data centers won't be built due to lack of grid power.

title: Banks get creative as AI-fueled corporate debt soars

Amazon raised €14.5 billion in March from an eight-part deal, the largest ever in the euro corporate bond market, while Alphabet set borrowing records in yen, Canadian dollars, Swiss francs, and sterling. Capital expenditures for hyperscalers this year are estimated at around $725 billion, nearly double the level seen in mid‑2025, and spending is rising faster than operating cash flow, creating the need for external funding. Bankers are also structuring deals around pre-arranged data center leases to provide more visibility on future cash flows, with about 15 such deals sold to high-yield investors since last year, including an $810 million note issued by Stingray Compute that was nine times oversubscribed. title: DeepSeek's DSpark Makes Nvidia's LPX Decode Rack a Tougher Sell
brief_text: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark speculative decoding module is making it harder for Nvidia to sell its new Groq 3 LPX decode rack as a required upgrade for agentic AI workloads. DSpark, released under an MIT license, boosts per-user generation speed by 60% to 85% on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and 57% to 78% on V4-Pro by reducing the number of full decode passes needed per output. Combined with DeepSeek's MLA architecture, which cuts KV cache memory requirements by over 90%, these software innovations directly shrink the decode bottleneck that LPX is designed to monetize. Nvidia's LPX rack, built around 256 Groq LPU accelerators and paired with Vera Rubin GPUs, requires a separate purchase decision from customers who have already committed to Rubin systems. The bear case is that DSpark running on general Rubin GPUs alone may deliver enough inference efficiency to make LPX optional for most workloads, especially as hyperscalers like AWS and Cerebras launch competing disaggregated inference solutions on the same 2026 timeline.
reason: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark module boosts inference speed and reduces decode bottlenecks, strengthening its competitive position.

title: Soaring AI bills push businesses toward cheaper models

brief_text: A surge in equity sales by major technology companies is raising concerns among bond investors about an impending wave of debt issuance to fund artificial intelligence spending. title: SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI IPOs could trigger targeted tech sell-off, not 40% crash
brief_text: The upcoming IPOs of SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI are unlikely to cause a 40% stock market crash, but they could spark a painful correction in AI and tech stocks as fund managers sell existing positions to make room. Financial commentator Mark Hulbert cited research suggesting the roughly $200 billion combined raise could shrink total market cap by $1 trillion, but strategist Ed Yardeni argues the effect is manageable given the over $50 trillion U.S. equity market and $8 trillion in money market funds. The real risk is rotation pressure: when the Nasdaq dropped 4.18% on June 5 ahead of SpaceX's pricing, hedge funds sold chip stocks and AI infrastructure names, and similar selling could hit Nvidia, AMD, and others if Anthropic and OpenAI debut within 12 months. Nasdaq rule changes now allow megacap IPOs into the Nasdaq-100 within 15 days, forcing passive funds like QQQ to buy, which could displace existing heavyweights like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Apple. Historical 40% crashes involved forced selling by leveraged investors, not crowded IPO calendars, and the dot-com bubble peaked before the IPO pipeline overflowed, suggesting valuation problems come first.

title: US private credit market recalibrates in Q2 2026 as software falls from favor
brief_text: The US private credit market underwent a significant recalibration in the second quarter of 2026, with lenders and investors reassessing exposure to software and other once-favored sectors amid geopolitical turmoil and AI-driven disruption. Direct lending deal volume fell sharply to $29.2 billion across 138 transactions through June 22, well below the $74.1 billion across 217 deals in the first quarter, according to LCD data. The war in Iran and the release of Anthropic's Claude Cowork, which fueled a global sell-off of software and IT companies, compounded existing negativity and stymied M&A and buyout activity. Healthcare surpassed technology as the largest sector by new deal count, while lenders demanded pristine metrics from software borrowers, with Vista Credit Partners estimating that about 20% of software businesses are in a 'failure to thrive' category. Despite the slowdown, pricing improved for lenders, with spreads widening roughly 25 to 50 basis points, and Apollo and Blackstone led a $36 billion investment-grade structured notes financing for AI giant Anthropic, though it was excluded from direct lending volume due to its structure. Redemption pressures intensified at non-traded BDCs, with Blackstone Private Credit Fund's redemption demand climbing to 10% in Q2, while the nascent secondary market for private credit loans saw a pickup in activity, with JPMorgan trading roughly $2 billion worth of loans as of mid-May.

title: DeepSeek's DSpark Makes Nvidia's LPX Decode Rack a Tougher Sell
brief_text: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark speculative decoding module is making it harder for Nvidia to sell its new Groq 3 LPX decode rack as a required upgrade for agentic AI workloads. DSpark, released under an MIT license, boosts per-user generation speed by 60% to 85% on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and 57% to 78% on V4-Pro by reducing the number of full decode passes needed per output. Combined with DeepSeek's MLA architecture, which cuts KV cache memory requirements by over 90%, these software innovations directly shrink the decode bottleneck that LPX is designed to monetize. Nvidia's LPX rack, built around 256 Groq LPU accelerators and paired with Vera Rubin GPUs, requires a separate purchase decision from customers who have already committed to Rubin systems. The bear case is that DSpark running on general Rubin GPUs alone may deliver enough inference efficiency to make LPX optional for most workloads, especially as hyperscalers like AWS and Cerebras launch competing disaggregated inference solutions on the same 2026 timeline.
reason: DeepSeek's open-source DSpark module boosts inference speed and reduces decode bottlenecks, strengthening its competitive position.

title: Soaring AI bills push businesses toward cheaper models
brief_text: A growing number of tech CEOs say cheaper AI models are crucial for wider adoption as soaring and unpredictable bills reshape how businesses choose their tools. title: Apple lobbies White House to buy chips from blacklisted Chinese firm CXMT
brief_text: Apple is lobbying the Trump administration for clearance to buy memory chips from ChangXin Memory Technologies, a Chinese company the Pentagon has blacklisted, the Financial Times reported. title: CFTC is conducting an investigation into Polymarket, source says
brief_text: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has an ongoing, extensive investigation into prediction market platform Polymarket, according to a person familiar with the inquiry. News of the investigation comes more than a week after a Wall Street Journal story revealed that Polymarket conducted a misleading marketing campaign, making content creators appear as though they were winning on the platform when in reality they were not putting any money down. The CFTC investigation marks a reversal for Polymarket's regulatory fortunes over the past year, as investigations by the CFTC and the Department of Justice were dropped in July of last year without charges after the company was originally banned from allowing U.S. users in 2022 for not properly registering with regulators. Polymarket's CFTC-regulated U.S. exchange launched in December, reopening access to domestic users, and a waitlist to access the platform was lifted six weeks ago. The CFTC under Chairman Michael Selig has been aggressive in its support for prediction markets, but the investigation into Polymarket would mark the commission's first high-profile inquiry into an event contract platform under his leadership.
reason: CFTC investigation into Polymarket for potential regulatory violations

title: Africa's largest crypto exchange VALR integrates Hyperliquid, adding over 200 perpetual futures markets

title: 9Pay becomes direct payment partner with Visa, driving cross-border payment solutions

title: Kraken Allows Tokenized Stocks as Collateral for Leveraged Trading
brief_text: Major crypto exchange Kraken announced on July 3 that it will allow certain tokenized stocks and ETFs to be used as collateral for futures and margin trading. Initially, 10 assets including SPYx, QQQx, AAPLx, TSLAx, and NVDAx are eligible, with index ETFs receiving a 10% haircut and individual stocks generally 20 to 30%, along with per-asset collateral caps. xStocks are tokens issued by Backed Assets JE Limited and backed one-to-one by physical shares or ETFs. Kraken acquired the issuer Backed Finance in December 2025, establishing an integrated operation from issuance to trading and settlement. Since launching in June 2025, cumulative trading volume has exceeded 25 billion dollars, and the number of supported assets has surpassed 100. This move is part of a broader trend of integrating tokenized assets into credit trading infrastructure. In June, Kraken also partnered with Maple to launch a lending facility for institutional investors, reflecting an industry-wide shift toward using tokenized real-world assets as collateral and credit foundations. xStocks are not available in the United States or Japan.
reason: Kraken launches tokenized stocks as collateral for leveraged trading, expanding its product offering.

title: World Cup drives prediction market volumes to record highs in June
brief_text: Prediction market platforms saw record trading volumes in June, fueled by the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Kalshi reported over $31 billion in notional volume, a more than 70% increase from May's $17.9 billion, and has consistently exceeded $1 billion daily since the tournament began on June 11. Polymarket's international exchange set a new monthly record with notional trading above $10.8 billion, reversing declines in April and May, while its U.S. platform did over $3.5 billion, up from $1.77 billion in May. New entrant Rothera, a joint venture between Susquehanna International Group and Robinhood, debuted in June with $2 billion in notional volume, capturing 7% of the U.S. prediction market, according to Bank of America. Open interest also rose, with Kalshi above $1 billion and Polymarket just under $400 million, as platforms used the World Cup to test their ability to handle sustained high-volume environments under regulatory scrutiny.

brief_text: The digital payments industry is undergoing a second revolution, moving beyond replacing cash to rebuilding infrastructure that makes payments invisible and settlement speed a competitive feature. brief_text: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has urged his lieutenants to explore partnerships with prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi as the company builds a similar app, the New York Times reported, citing three employees with knowledge of the matter. Meta’s new prediction market app under development, called Arena, will differ from Polymarket and Kalshi by relying on video-game-like points instead of real-money wagers. Zuckerberg’s target demographic for Arena is 18- to 34-year-olds, and Meta aims to reach at least 100 million monthly active predictors. Arena is being tested internally and may not be released, though Meta plans to eventually integrate parts of it into Facebook and Messenger.
reason: Zuckerberg's interest in exploring partnerships with Kalshi could lead to increased visibility and user adoption for Kalshi.

title: QuantRate upgrades global trading infrastructure for AI trading bots
brief_text: Fintech platform QuantRate announced a major upgrade to its global trading access infrastructure, designed to improve automated trading execution efficiency and enhance multi-asset quantitative strategy performance. The upgrade expands global trading connectivity, allowing AI trading bots to access more international liquidity markets while maintaining stable execution in high-volatility conditions. It leverages a distributed computing architecture to optimize trade routing, reduce latency, and improve order execution accuracy. The system also introduces advanced risk management features, including volatility forecasting models, dynamic stop-loss mechanisms, and capital allocation optimization algorithms. QuantRate stated that the upgrade enables retail investors to access AI-driven intelligent trading systems more efficiently, supporting growing demand for automated trading tools in forex, cryptocurrency, and CFD markets.

title: High Roller Technologies secures NFA introducing broker license for U.S. prediction markets launch
brief_text: High Roller Technologies has received approval from the National Futures Association to register its subsidiary ROLR US LLC as a guaranteed introducing broker, clearing a key regulatory hurdle for its planned U.S. prediction markets platform. The registration allows ROLR US LLC to operate under a guarantee agreement with OG Markets US, doing business as Crypto.com FCM, which will carry customer accounts and provide transaction processing, custody, and regulatory infrastructure. Eligible ROLR customers are expected to gain access to event contracts offered by Crypto.com | Derivatives North America across sports, finance, entertainment, and other real-world events, with CDNA serving as the exclusive provider of prediction contracts through High Roller's U.S. platform for the initial 24 months. High Roller anticipates participating economically through a revenue-sharing arrangement tied to customer activity, and the company is now focused on final integration, testing, and operational elements ahead of its target launch date.
reason: ROLR US LLC registered as guaranteed introducing broker, enabling U.S. operations.

title: Husher Launches Instant Crypto Swap Platform With 2-Second Settlement and No-KYC Access
brief_text: Husher, a non-custodial crypto exchange, announced benchmark results showing it completed a roughly $1,000 SOL swap in 2 seconds with a 0.34% all-in fee, outperforming competitors like ChangeNOW, FixedFloat, and SimpleSwap. The platform offers private-by-default swaps without KYC requirements, with fees ranging from 0.1% to 0.4%. In testing, Husher settled more than 20 times faster than ChangeNOW and returned the most value to users. It integrates liquidity from over 10 exchanges and provides optional enhanced privacy routing through XMR and ZEC. The service is accessible via web and a Telegram bot, maintaining the same speed and privacy features.

title: Kalshi Targets $40 Billion Valuation Ahead Of IPO
brief_text: Prediction market Kalshi is seeking to raise new capital at a valuation of $40 billion U.S., nearly double the $22 billion U.S. valuation from its last funding round. The company is preparing for an initial public offering likely in 2027, depending on market conditions, and aims to complete the new funding round by the end of this year's third quarter. The $40 billion U.S. valuation would put Kalshi ahead of rival Polymarket, which was last valued at $15 billion U.S. Kalshi operates as a federally regulated exchange in the U.S., while Polymarket uses blockchain infrastructure and crypto-based settlements from Panama outside U.S. regulators' jurisdiction. Competition in the prediction market sector is intensifying with new entrants including Robinhood Markets and DraftKings.
reason: Kalshi is seeking new capital at a $40B valuation, nearly double its previous round, ahead of a planned IPO.

title: MX Announces Enterprise-Grade Conversational Financial AI Assistant
brief_text: MX Technologies has announced a first-of-its-kind, enterprise-grade conversational financial AI assistant designed to turn enriched financial data into real-time answers, accurate forecasts, and governed consumer workflows for banks, credit unions, and fintechs. brief_text: GIX, one of only ten registered stock exchange operators in the U.S., has appointed Sara Dillon as Chief Technology Officer. brief_text: Toobit has announced zero-fee trading across selected spot pairs from June 26 through September 26, 2026. title: VanEck's Matthew Sigel Predicts Bitcoin Could Soar to $2.9 Million by 2050
brief_text: VanEck's head of digital assets research, Matthew Sigel, has issued a series of bullish Bitcoin price predictions, including a near-term target of $160,000, a medium-term forecast of $1 million, and a long-term projection of $2.9 million by 2050. Sigel's $160,000 call is based on Bitcoin's valuation multiple relative to gold recovering to 35, while the $1 million target hinges on expanding user adoption as younger generations invest. The $2.9 million forecast, published in a January VanEck analysis, assumes Bitcoin will become the settlement currency for 5% to 10% of global trade and a reserve asset comprising 2.5% of central bank balance sheets, growing at a 15% compound annual rate. Bitcoin currently trades around $60,000, down from its October 2025 all-time high of $126,000, and its fixed supply of 21 million coins underpins the bull case. However, the $1 million and $2.9 million targets would imply market caps approaching or exceeding the estimated $28 trillion value of all gold, a comparison the article's author views as highly speculative given Bitcoin's limited real-world utility compared to the precious metal.

title: Bitbank CEO Noriyuki Hiromi on the limits of standalone crypto and the rationale behind joining SBI
brief_text: Bitbank President and CEO Noriyuki Hiromi revealed that the decision to become a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Group was driven by the recognition that standalone crypto has its limits. Speaking at a panel session in the IVS2026 CRYPTO ZONE, Hiromi pointed to the burdens of advanced regulatory compliance, system investment, and talent acquisition accompanying the transition under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, and expressed the view that collaboration with groups possessing existing financial functions such as banking and securities is essential. He said that joining SBI Group was a decision that prioritized responsibility to shareholders, customers, and employees, and indicated that integration will proceed first in administrative departments and systems. He also likened the full application of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act to asking elementary school students to take a university entrance exam, and expressed the view that a phased approach was necessary.
reason: CEO notes regulatory compliance burden under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, but joining SBI Group is framed as a positive strategic move to address it.

brief_text: NOTO has launched a strategic partnership with Equifax UK to enable the launch of Automatic Watchlist Monitoring, a new Anti-Money Laundering solution. The alliance leverages NOTO's real-time screening engine, NOTO 360, to deliver sub-100ms response times with no transaction volume limits, screening against global sanctions, politically exposed persons, and adverse media lists. The solution addresses the UK's evolving regulatory requirements, including the Financial Conduct Authority's Finalised Guidance FG25/3 and strengthened expectations from the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation. It provides configurable thresholds, 360-degree coverage across the customer journey, and a complete audit trail for due diligence. The service is integrated via a REST API and uses Equifax proprietary data sources to help clients manage compliance risk efficiently.
reason: NOTO launches a strategic partnership with Equifax UK for its AML solution, driving adoption and revenue.

title: Alkami Integrates FDX API With Yodlee for Financial Data Sharing
brief_text: Alkami Technology announced an integration with Yodlee to shift data sharing services to the Financial Data Exchange application programming interface. The company said the transition will improve performance and reduce login disruptions for users accessing third-party financial applications, supporting both security and user experience. The FDX API integration is built into Alkami's digital banking platform and enables credential-free, consent-based authentication for sharing financial data between institutions and third-party services. Alkami expects the integration to make data sharing more efficient, reducing support inquiries and lowering infrastructure strain. The company provides a digital sales and service platform for community banks and credit unions.
reason: Yodlee is the integration partner, benefiting from Alkami's adoption of its data sharing services.

title: Strategy's TEOCO deal rebalances narrative toward AI software amid Bitcoin pressure
brief_text: TEOCO Corporation selected Strategy's cloud-native Strategy One platform to power its SmartCOGS BillTrak Analysis Module, embedding generative AI into telecom cost management workflows. The partnership extends Strategy's AI and BI capabilities into wholesale invoice and inventory analytics for communications service providers. While the deal is unlikely to offset a US$12,773.70 million loss or the intense focus on shoring up US$1.40 billion of reserves, it slightly rebalances the near-term story away from pure Bitcoin leverage toward software relevance. title: MUFG and JCB Form Comprehensive Partnership in Southeast Asia to Strengthen Wealth Management and Payments
brief_text: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group announced on the 6th that it has signed a memorandum of understanding with major credit card company JCB for a strategic comprehensive partnership in ASEAN. Leveraging both companies' customer bases and financial and payment networks, they aim to expand their business in the region by strengthening services for wealthy individuals. As a key pillar of the partnership, they will collaborate with MUFG Bank's partner banks, such as Thailand's Bank of Ayudhya and Indonesia's Bank Danamon, to combine JCB's international payment network and merchant base, offering services that integrate finance and payments. As a first initiative this fiscal year, they plan to issue JCB's highest-tier overseas card in Indonesia. They will also explore combining the payment functions of JCB with digital financial businesses in which MUFG has invested, to enhance cross-border and mobile payment capabilities.

title: U.S. Government Blocks Anthropic's New AI Models, Boosting Bittensor
brief_text: The U.S. government has blocked Anthropic's newest AI models and restricted OpenAI's upcoming release, triggering a 30% price spike in decentralized AI network Bittensor. On June 12, the Trump administration ordered Anthropic to suspend foreign access to its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models, with Mythos 5 rumored to be exceptionally powerful for cybersecurity. Within hours, Anthropic pulled both models globally, and Bittensor's token TAO surged 30% in 12 hours. On June 25, the White House told OpenAI to release its GPT-5.6 model only to a government-vetted elite, introducing risks for enterprises relying on centralized AI platforms. Bittensor, a network of subnets enabling decentralized AI training and services, could serve as a workaround to these restrictions, though its ability to rival frontier models remains unproven.

brief_text: Bullish has received approval from the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission to trade tokenized securities, becoming one of the first regulated platforms for issuer-sponsored digital assets. title: Fed’s new stablecoin rules could make Circle the biggest winner
brief_text: The Federal Reserve proposed new rules in mid-June requiring stablecoin issuers to verify customer identities before opening accounts or redeeming tokens, applying bank-style anti-money laundering standards. The tighter restrictions could strengthen Circle, issuer of USD Coin, by widening its regulatory moat against competitors like Tether, which is issued by Hong Kong-based iFinex and backed by an opaque mix of assets. Circle promotes USD Coin as a tightly regulated, US-centric stablecoin firmly backed by dollars and Treasuries, and the Fed’s proposal would make it even harder for Tether to challenge USD Coin in the U.S. market. Circle’s application for a U.S. bank charter was conditionally approved last December, and a clearer regulatory framework could support its evolution into a federally chartered bank. Analysts expect Circle’s revenue to nearly double from 2025 to 2028, with adjusted EBITDA more than doubling, and the company currently has an enterprise value of $15.9 billion.
reason: Tighter stablecoin rules disadvantage iFinex's Tether, which is backed by opaque assets.

title: Qualcomm Targets $15 Billion in Data Center Sales by 2029
brief_text: Qualcomm expects to generate $15 billion in sales from its data center business by 2029, moving beyond its core smartphone chips. The company also anticipates $40 billion in revenue from chips outside its smartphone stronghold by 2029, up from previous estimates of $22 billion, with handsets making up only a third of its chip revenue by then. Separately, Qualcomm is in advanced talks to acquire AI infrastructure software company Modular Inc in a deal valued at around $4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
reason: Qualcomm is in advanced talks to acquire Modular Inc for ~$4B, a positive valuation event for Modular.

title: CFTC is conducting an investigation into Polymarket, source says
brief_text: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has an ongoing, extensive investigation into prediction market platform Polymarket, according to a person familiar with the inquiry. The Wall Street Journal first reported the investigation on Friday. A spokesperson for the CFTC and another for Polymarket both declined to comment. News of the investigation comes more than a week after a Wall Street Journal story revealed that Polymarket conducted a misleading marketing campaign, making content creators appear as though they were winning on the platform when in reality they were not putting any money down. The person familiar with the inquiry, who was not authorized to speak publicly, did not disclose a timeline for when the commission's investigation into Polymarket began. Polymarket reiterated to CNBC that it is taking steps in response to the Journal's investigation into its marketing, with a spokesperson stating the company is conducting a comprehensive audit of active promotional content to ensure it complies with its standards as well as applicable regulatory and legal disclosure requirements. The CFTC investigation marks a reversal for Polymarket's regulatory fortunes over the past year, as investigations by the CFTC and the Department of Justice were dropped in July of last year without charges after the company was originally banned from allowing U.S. users in 2022 for not properly registering with regulators. Polymarket's CFTC-regulated U.S. exchange launched in December, reopening access to domestic users, and a waitlist to access the platform was lifted six weeks ago. The CFTC under Chairman Michael Selig has been aggressive in its support for prediction markets, but the investigation into Polymarket would mark the commission's first high-profile inquiry into an event contract platform under his leadership.
reason: CFTC investigation into Polymarket for potential regulatory violations

Kraken has recently increased acquisitions, agreeing in April to buy crypto derivatives platform Bitnomial for $550 million U.S., as it builds a multi-asset platform ahead of a potential IPO in the second half of this year.

title: Iranian entities moved $3.8B through crypto exchange CoinEx
brief_text: Iranian entities have moved more than $3.84 billion in transactions through the crypto exchange CoinEx, according to an analysis of public blockchain data. The exchange reportedly filled a vacuum left after Binance tightened compliance and cut off sanctioned entities. The same analysis also found that some of the $1.5 billion in Ethereum and other coins hacked from Bybit by North Korea last year ended up in wallets linked to Iran's central bank, though there is no evidence of direct coordination between the two countries. The findings highlight how illicit actors can shift to less regulated platforms when major exchanges enforce stricter controls.

title: Binance withdraws Greek MiCA bid, risks losing Europe access by July 1
brief_text: Binance has withdrawn its application for a MiCA license in Greece, putting its ability to operate across the European Union at risk when the new crypto regulations take effect on July 1. The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange had been seeking a single license from one EU regulator, which would have allowed it to passport services across all 27 EU and 30 EEA countries. Co-CEO Richard Teng stated that a license will be obtained in the coming months, but not by the July 1 deadline, and assured users that funds remain safe. The withdrawal comes as only about 200 of over 3,000 applicants are expected to receive MiCA licenses, with just 14 able to run a trading platform. Binance faces a tight timeline to secure approval from another regulator, while competitors like OKX, Kraken, and Coinbase have already obtained their licenses.
reason: Kraken already has a MiCA license, benefiting from Binance's regulatory setback.

title: Binance sees $1.2 billion in outflows, roughly triple the previous week
brief_text: Crypto exchange Binance recorded net outflows of $1.23 billion last week, roughly triple the approximately $400 million from the previous week. title: Kraken Allows Tokenized Stocks as Collateral for Leveraged Trading
brief_text: Major crypto exchange Kraken announced on July 3 that it will allow certain tokenized stocks and ETFs to be used as collateral for futures and margin trading. Initially, 10 assets including SPYx, QQQx, AAPLx, TSLAx, and NVDAx are eligible, with index ETFs receiving a 10% haircut and individual stocks generally 20 to 30%, along with per-asset collateral caps. xStocks are tokens issued by Backed Assets JE Limited and backed one-to-one by physical shares or ETFs. Kraken acquired the issuer Backed Finance in December 2025, establishing an integrated operation from issuance to trading and settlement. Since launching in June 2025, cumulative trading volume has exceeded 25 billion dollars, and the number of supported assets has surpassed 100. This move is part of a broader trend of integrating tokenized assets into credit trading infrastructure. In June, Kraken also partnered with Maple to launch a lending facility for institutional investors, reflecting an industry-wide shift toward using tokenized real-world assets as collateral and credit foundations. xStocks are not available in the United States or Japan.
reason: Kraken launches tokenized stocks as collateral for leveraged trading, expanding its product offering.

Initially, 10 assets including SPYx, QQQx, AAPLx, TSLAx, and NVDAx are eligible, with index ETFs receiving a 10% haircut and individual stocks generally 20 to 30%, along with per-asset collateral caps. xStocks are tokens issued by Backed Assets JE Limited and backed one-to-one by physical shares or ETFs. Kraken acquired the issuer Backed Finance in December 2025, establishing an integrated operation from issuance to trading and settlement. Since launching in June 2025, cumulative trading volume has exceeded 25 billion dollars, and the number of supported assets has surpassed 100. This move is part of a broader trend of integrating tokenized assets into credit trading infrastructure. In June, Kraken also partnered with Maple to launch a lending facility for institutional investors, reflecting an industry-wide shift toward using tokenized real-world assets as collateral and credit foundations. xStocks are not available in the United States or Japan.
reason: Kraken's expansion into tokenized collateral aligns with Maple's lending facility, potentially increasing demand for Maple's services.

title: Revolut to Phase Out USDT Handling in Line with MiCA Transition
brief_text: European fintech major Revolut has notified customers that it will gradually phase out handling of the stablecoin USDT. New purchases will be possible until July 6, but deposits will no longer be accepted after July 30, and sales or withdrawals to external wallets will be allowed until August 31. After that, any USDT balances remaining in accounts will be automatically converted to fiat currency at market rates. Revolut explained the reason as regulatory and risk considerations, and the move is seen against the backdrop of restrictions on offering stablecoins from unlicensed issuers under the MiCA license the company obtained from the Cyprus Securities and Exchange Commission in November 2025. Tether's CEO has criticized the MiCA regulations, and USDT has a market capitalization of 184 billion dollars, ranking third among all crypto assets, while rival USD Coin stands at 73 billion dollars, ranking fifth. Major exchanges Binance, Kraken, and Coinbase have already been ending USDT handling in Europe sequentially since 2024, and Revolut's decision follows this trend. Japanese exchanges do not handle USDT, and due to the lack of a framework under the amended Payment Services Act, the direct impact is low, but it draws attention as part of a global trend toward tighter regulation.
reason: Binance already ended USDT handling in Europe; this news is not new for them.

title: World Cup drives prediction market volumes to record highs in June
brief_text: Prediction market platforms saw record trading volumes in June, fueled by the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Kalshi reported over $31 billion in notional volume, a more than 70% increase from May's $17.9 billion, and has consistently exceeded $1 billion daily since the tournament began on June 11. Polymarket's international exchange set a new monthly record with notional trading above $10.8 billion, reversing declines in April and May, while its U.S. platform did over $3.5 billion, up from $1.77 billion in May. New entrant Rothera, a joint venture between Susquehanna International Group and Robinhood, debuted in June with $2 billion in notional volume, capturing 7% of the U.S. prediction market, according to Bank of America. Open interest also rose, with Kalshi above $1 billion and Polymarket just under $400 million, as platforms used the World Cup to test their ability to handle sustained high-volume environments under regulatory scrutiny.
reason: Kalshi reported record $31 billion notional volume in June, up 70% from May, driven by World Cup.

brief_text: Bitget השיקה אופציות למניות אמריקאיות, והפכה לבורסה הקריפטוגרפית הגדולה היחידה שמציעה מכשיר זה לצד שוק הקריפטו וחוזי הפרשים על זהב, פורקס, סחורות ומדדים. התכונות הפעילות כוללות אסטרטגיות לונג קול ולונג פוט, המאפשרות לסוחרים להביע עמדה חיובית או פסימית על מניה תוך סיכון מוגבל לפרמיה ששולמה. ההשקה מרחיבה את קו מוצרי המניות של Bitget, שהציגה בעבר אסימוני מניות וגישת קדם הנפקה, ומוסיפה מכשיר נפוץ מוול סטריט להיצע Stock+ שלה. המנכ"לית גרייסי צ'ן ציינה כי החברה פועלת בעקביות לחיבור הזדמנויות מניות עם משתמשיה, והמוצרים מקדימים את זמנם במתן גישה מתקדמת למסחר במניות, זהב, קריפטו ונכסים גלובליים. הגרסה הראשונית מתמקדת ברכישת אופציות חד-פעמיות, ואסטרטגיות מתקדמות יותר מתוכננות בהמשך.

title: Africa's largest crypto exchange VALR integrates Hyperliquid, adding over 200 perpetual futures markets
brief_text: VALR, Africa's largest crypto exchange, has announced the integration of Hyperliquid's layer-1 blockchain, enabling trading in over 200 perpetual futures markets covering individual stocks, commodities, foreign exchange, equity indices, and crypto assets. This marks the first instance of a major regulated exchange natively integrating an on-chain layer-1 liquidity protocol for multi-asset perpetual futures trading globally. The new perpetual futures products will launch on VALR's web platform on July 6, 2026, with mobile support to follow. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa, VALR is backed by Pantera Capital, Coinbase Ventures, and Fidelity-affiliated F-Prime Capital. Meanwhile, Hyperliquid's HYPE spot ETF saw net inflows of approximately 164 million dollars in June, sustaining institutional demand even as funds flowed out of other major crypto investment products like Bitcoin and Ethereum. However, on July 6, an estimated 9.9 to 10 million HYPE tokens are expected to enter circulation through cliff vesting for key contributors, potentially adding over 400 million dollars in new supply at current prices. Hyperliquid has been absorbing selling pressure through buybacks funded by protocol revenue, with cumulative revenue exceeding 1.027 billion dollars and roughly 99 percent of trading fees allocated to HYPE repurchases. On the technical front, HYPE price is holding support near 63 dollars and attempting to break resistance at 71 dollars.
reason: VALR integrates Hyperliquid's layer-1 blockchain, adding 200+ perpetual futures markets.

title: Ripple Launches AI Agent Payment Kit on XRP Ledger
brief_text: Ripple has released the XRP Ledger AI Starter Kit, enabling autonomous AI agents to make payments in XRP and Ripple's dollar-backed stablecoin using the x402 protocol. The XRPL joins other blockchains like Solana and Ethereum in supporting x402, which has already processed roughly 35 million transactions on Solana since its May 2025 launch. Ripple is targeting financial institutions with fast finality, low fees, and compliance tools, but XRP's tokenomics mean transaction fees are burned rather than distributed to holders, limiting potential upside. At current burn rates, removing even 1% of the outstanding supply would take more than 154 years.
reason: Ripple launches AI agent payment kit on XRPL, targeting financial institutions with fast finality and low fees.

title: Manole Capital says ICE’s Polymarket investment validates prediction markets
brief_text: Manole Capital Management highlighted Intercontinental Exchange’s strategic investment in prediction-market platform Polymarket as a validation of the emerging financial infrastructure category. In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, the firm noted that ICE has branched out from traditional derivatives, futures, options, and cash equities exchanges to take a strategic position in the predictive space, a move it described as typical of ICE’s approach to new and adjacent technologies. Manole Capital argued that the increasing participation of established financial institutions and market infrastructure providers is a more important signal than the growth of any individual prediction market platform. Intercontinental Exchange closed at $132.99 per share on July 2, 2026, with a market capitalization of $75.21 billion, and posted a one-month return of negative 6.01% and a 52-week decline of 27.37%.
reason: Polymarket receives strategic investment from ICE, validating its platform and boosting its credibility.

title: Bitget Launches Crypto Industry's First US Stock Options Trading
brief_text: Bitget has launched US stock options, becoming the only major crypto exchange to offer options on leading US-listed companies alongside crypto and CFD markets. The new long call and long put features allow traders to take bullish or bearish positions, with risk limited to the premium paid. This expands Bitget's Stock+ product line, which already includes tokenized stocks and pre-IPO access, and aligns with its goal of creating a multi-asset trading environment. The US options market processed over 15.2 billion contracts in 2025, averaging roughly 60 million contracts per trading day. To mark the launch, eligible users completing their first US stock options trade may receive $15 worth of NVIDIA stock, subject to terms and regional availability.
reason: Bitget launches US stock options trading, a new product feature that expands its multi-asset platform.

brief_text: Coinbase shares rose 4.1% in morning trading, extending gains from the previous day, after the company joined a major partnership to launch a new stablecoin called Open USD. The initiative brings together over 140 companies from the technology and financial sectors, including Google, BlackRock, Visa, and Mastercard. Separately, Spiko integrated Coinbase Payments into two European Treasury bill funds, enabling clients to use stablecoins for investment. The stock had surged 11.3% the prior day on the initial announcement. Coinbase is down 29.4% year-to-date, trading at $166.97 per share.

title: Freedom gets regulatory nod to buy 99.32% of Turkish Bank
brief_text: Freedom Finansal Hizmetler has received approval from Türkiye's Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency and the Competition Authority to acquire 99.32% of Turkish Bank from Özyol Holding and the National Bank of Kuwait. Once completed, Turkish Bank will join Freedom Holding's existing brokerage, investment, and capital markets units in Türkiye while remaining under Turkish regulatory oversight, and will be linked to Freedom's digital financial services and technology-based distribution. The approval comes as Freedom Holding finalizes its brokerage setup in the country, with plans to later expand into e-commerce, telecommunications, and lifestyle services.

brief_text: National Payments Corporation of India has partnered with HSBC India and JP Morgan Payments to enable real-time foreign exchange settlement for cross-border transactions made through the Unified Payments Interface. HSBC India and JP Morgan Payments will act as banking partners, providing real-time FX rates via direct API integration so customers can see the exact INR amount payable at the point of transaction. UPI is currently live in nine international markets, and its international transaction volume crossed one million for the first time in the current fiscal year.

title: Murphy Law Firm Investigates MCBS Data Breach Exposing Personal Information
brief_text: Murphy Law Firm is investigating claims on behalf of individuals whose personal information was compromised in a data breach at MCBS, LLC. MCBS detected suspicious network activity on or about September 25, 2025, and a forensic investigation found that cybercriminals accessed files containing sensitive data of hundreds of thousands of individuals. Exposed information includes names, Social Security numbers, medical information, addresses, dates of birth, and health insurance information. The firm is evaluating a potential class action lawsuit to seek compensation for those affected.

title: Meta invests $900 million in Cred, founder Kunal Shah to lead WhatsApp
brief_text: Meta Platforms is investing $900 million in Indian fintech startup Cred and bringing its founder Kunal Shah in to lead WhatsApp. The move is an acquihire aimed at boosting monetization of WhatsApp, which has over 3 billion monthly active users but contributed a maximum of only about 1.6% of Meta's total revenue last quarter. Shah's experience growing Cred to over 170 million users and processing more than 40% of India's credit card bill payments is expected to help scale WhatsApp's payment features, particularly in India where WhatsApp Pay holds just 0.65% of the Unified Payments Interface market. With over 500 million WhatsApp users in India, success there could extend to other international markets that account for more than 95% of the platform's user base. Analysts have projected WhatsApp could generate more than $30 billion in revenue.
reason: Cred receives $900M investment from Meta and its founder will lead WhatsApp

title: Goldman Lampe Private Bank Acquires €120 Million in Bitcoin During Market Dip
brief_text: Goldman Lampe Private Bank has purchased approximately €120 million worth of Bitcoin, capitalizing on a recent cryptocurrency market correction. The bank, which is the world’s first to introduce cryptocurrency term deposits, made the acquisition to strengthen its institutional holdings and reaffirm its leadership in integrating traditional private banking with digital asset solutions. Chairman Abdullah Hamad Al Shamsi stated that Bitcoin continues to show resilience as a store of value and strategic asset, and the purchase reflects confidence in its role within diversified portfolios amid growing institutional adoption. Headquartered in Ras al Khaimah, UAE, Goldman Lampe Private Bank has been a pioneer in offering regulated crypto term deposits with competitive yields.

title: OpenPayd files registration statement for Nasdaq listing via Titan Acquisition Corp merger
brief_text: OpenPayd has filed a registration statement on Form F-4 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for its proposed business combination with Titan Acquisition Corp., a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company. The transaction is expected to result in OpenPayd becoming a Nasdaq-listed public company under the ticker symbol OP, with an implied pro forma equity value exceeding $1 billion. OpenPayd shareholders would receive aggregate consideration based on a value of $800 million, and the deal could provide up to approximately $276 million in gross proceeds from Titan's trust account, assuming no redemptions. OpenPayd, a financial infrastructure platform for programmable money movement, reported more than $85 million in annualized recurring revenue as of March 2026 and over $240 billion in annualized transaction volume. The business combination, approved by both companies' boards, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and a minimum aggregate transaction proceeds condition of $130 million.

title: Bron and Noah Partner to Bring Global Stablecoin On- and Off-Ramp Access to Self-Custody
brief_text: Bron, a next-generation self-custody wallet, has partnered with Noah, a global stablecoin payments infrastructure provider, to integrate on- and off-ramp capabilities into Bron's wallet. The integration will allow Bron users to fund and withdraw from their self-custody wallets using stablecoins through Noah's global payments network, which operates in more than 70 countries. The companies aim to bridge traditional financial infrastructure with secure self-custody, addressing a major barrier to mainstream crypto adoption. Bron's wallet uses multi-party computation to eliminate seed phrases, while Noah provides stablecoin payment infrastructure to fintechs, exchanges, and global businesses.
reason: Bron integrates on- and off-ramp capabilities via Noah, enhancing its self-custody wallet's functionality and user experience.

title: Tether's gold reserves hit $23 billion, now used as loan collateral
brief_text: Tether's gold reserves have climbed to approximately 148 tonnes, worth roughly $23 billion as of January 31, according to Jefferies analysts. The holdings back both the USDT stablecoin and the XAUT token, placing Tether among the world's top 30 gold holders. Crypto lender Ledn has added support for XAUT and USDT, allowing users to hold Bitcoin and XAUT in transaction accounts and receive or repay loans in USDT or USAT. Later this year, users will be able to borrow against XAUT, with Tether stating that loan collateral will never be lent out for interest or used to fund the business.
reason: Ledn adds support for XAUT and USDT, enabling new loan products and attracting users.

title: Kalshi and Polymarket Could Become Takeover Targets, Says Bernstein
brief_text: Wall Street broker Bernstein says prediction markets Kalshi and Polymarket could become takeover targets amid industry consolidation. Analysts led by Ian Moore argue that while both companies own the exchange technology stack, they trail on distribution, making them plausible acquisition targets as new entrants like DraftKings, Robinhood, and Coinbase look to grow through mergers and acquisitions. Kalshi was recently valued at $40 billion and Polymarket at $15 billion, with Kalshi planning an IPO in late 2026 or early 2027. Bernstein notes that consolidation is inevitable as prediction markets converge with sports betting and consumer finance, and that owning exchanges allows companies to retain revenue previously lost to third-party platforms.

title: 9Pay becomes direct payment partner with Visa, driving cross-border payment solutions
brief_text: 9Pay Joint Stock Company has officially established a direct connection with Visa through CyberSource, a global payment processing platform within the Visa ecosystem. This strategic move positions 9Pay as one of the few payment intermediaries in Vietnam to possess card infrastructure capabilities equivalent to international operating standards. The partnership eliminates market entry barriers for foreign payment service providers and merchants by offering compliant cash flow management without requiring a local legal entity or Vietnamese payment intermediary license. 9Pay handles foreign exchange coordination, risk management, and specialized tax advisory, while the new infrastructure removes intermediary layers to optimize transaction approval rates and reduce cart abandonment. End-users in Vietnam can experience a frictionless payment flow fully in VND without hidden currency conversion fees, and automatically benefit from existing value-added ecosystems of Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Click to Pay.

title: Streamex, Siebert, and tZERO bring yield-bearing gold token GLDY to traditional brokerage accounts
brief_text: Streamex Corp. announced a collaboration with Siebert Financial Corp. and tZERO Group, Inc. to make its gold-backed, yield-bearing tokenized security GLDY available for purchase through Siebert’s wealth management and institutional distribution channels. Siebert oversees approximately $20 billion in assets under management, expanding access to GLDY for a broad base of accredited and institutional investors. The collaboration marks a convergence of traditional finance and blockchain-enabled markets, with a FINRA-member broker-dealer selling a blockchain-native tokenized security through standard infrastructure.

title: OwlTing Group and Saber Money Open Settlement into India's US$860 Billion Export Economy
brief_text: OwlTing Group announced the integration of Saber Money into OwlPay Harbor, opening direct payout settlement into India in Indian rupees. The integration also enables pay-in and payout capability in the Eurozone and the United Kingdom. India's exports of goods and services reached a record US$860 billion in its fiscal year ending March 2026, representing one of the world's largest cross-border payment markets. Through the integration, OwlTing's enterprise clients can initiate payments through OwlPay Harbor, with Saber and its authorized bank partners handling local settlement into India in near real time, replacing the multi-intermediary correspondent chain with a single regulated settlement path. OwlPay Harbor earns transaction-based fees on the volume it settles, and India is among the largest corridors it has added to date.
reason: Saber Money is integrated into OwlPay Harbor to handle local settlement into India, expanding its payment services.

Executive Director Lorenzo Calcagni stated that the AI Agentic Pricer explores a new frontier in accessing and distributing structured products by bringing institutional tools into everyday messaging interfaces, aligning with the company's vision of more efficient, transparent, and scalable investment solutions. Otala is also conducting advanced research into the tokenisation of structured products, aiming to complete the entire transaction lifecycle on a permissioned blockchain.

title: SQRIL enters Central Asia with stablecoin-to-QR code payments
brief_text: SQRIL, the scan-to-pay QR code API for crypto apps and neobanks, has expanded into Central Asia, adding Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan to its network. The company now operates in eleven countries across Asia, Africa, and Latin America, offering stablecoin-to-QR code payments that undercut traditional crypto cards with sub-1% transaction fees versus the typical 3% card fee. SQRIL leverages the 85% QR code merchant adoption rate in emerging markets, compared to just 15% for card acceptance, by connecting stablecoins directly to local instant payment rails. Founder and CEO Malcolm Weed stated that the infrastructure gives financial apps three times lower fees and access to five times more merchants than any crypto card program. The expansion is part of SQRIL's broader push to displace legacy card networks in emerging economies.
reason: Expansion into three new countries increases merchant network and user base for its stablecoin-to-QR payment service.

title: ICE Forms OKX Joint Venture and Launches GreenTrace Carbon Registry
brief_text: Intercontinental Exchange has formed a 50-50 joint venture with OKX to build infrastructure for tokenized and digitally native financial products, co-chaired by former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo, and separately launched ICE GreenTrace, an environmental registry platform supporting the full lifecycle of carbon credits. The OKX venture aims to give clients access to tokenized versions of ICE futures and NYSE-listed equities, subject to regulatory approvals for broker-dealer and futures commission merchant status. ICE GreenTrace has already seen Environmental Resources Trust migrate 437 million serialized credits and extensive historical data to the platform. These moves extend ICE's role beyond traditional exchange operations into blockchain-enabled trading and carbon markets, areas where competitors such as CME Group, Nasdaq and Cboe are also active.
reason: OKX formed a 50-50 JV with ICE to build infrastructure for tokenized financial products, expanding its reach.

title: Citigroup Launches Market-First Digital Depositary Receipts Program
brief_text: Citigroup launched a market-first Digital Depositary Receipts program on June 11 to provide private companies and investors with a more transparent, direct, and efficient way to access private market equity. By serving as both the single issuer and custodian, Citi aims to reduce costs and complexities associated with traditional secondary market structures. The solution uses blockchain infrastructure operated by SIX to tokenize private shares, offering an institutional-grade alternative to methods like Special Purpose Vehicles. The program debuted with an inaugural transaction involving Kaleido, showcasing a coordinated effort across Citi's business units to integrate digital assets into existing investment workflows. This new model allows private companies to access liquidity and broaden investor outreach without needing a public listing, and Citi plans to scale the offering across traditional and digital infrastructures in the future.
reason: SIX operates the blockchain infrastructure used by Citi's program, positioning it as a key technology partner.

title: Bitcoin falls below $58,000, hitting lowest since October 2024
brief_text: Bitcoin dropped below $58,000 this week, reaching its lowest level since October 2024, as markets reacted to a hot PCE print and Apple's announcement of 25% price increases. The cryptocurrency fell back under $60,000 and is trading near 2024 prices, with bulls watching for a recovery above the 200-day moving average in the low $60s by Sunday's close. In other developments, President Trump said he will not sign a major housing bill that included a CBDC ban until 2030 until Congress passes the Save Act on voter registration and ID. Binance withdrew its MiCA license application in Greece, effectively acknowledging it would not gain approval, and is now seeking another regulator, potentially causing issues for EU users. A report revealed that a China-based exchange called CoinX allegedly served as a laundering hub for both North Korean hackers from the Bybit hack and Iranians seeking to bypass sanctions. On a positive note, Bitmine will officially join the Russell 1000 index after market close today, bringing Ethereum exposure to many passive portfolios.
reason: Report alleges CoinX served as a laundering hub for North Korean hackers and Iranians, likely leading to regulatory crackdown.

title: Ripple Gets Preliminary EU License, Opening Door for XRP and RLUSD in Europe
brief_text: Ripple has received preliminary approval from Luxembourg's Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier for a Crypto Asset Service Provider license under the EU's MiCA regulation. Combined with a recently secured Electronic Money Institution license, Ripple can now offer its services, including the XRP Ledger and its stablecoin RLUSD, across all 30 European Economic Area countries. The approval comes just before a July 1 deadline that is expected to shrink the number of compliant crypto operators from over 1,200 to around 210, positioning Ripple as one of the largest remaining competitors. With Tether's USDT shut out of regulated EU venues, RLUSD has an opportunity to capture market share, potentially generating fees for the XRP Ledger and attracting capital. However, any value accrual to XRP token holders is expected to be modest and slow, as XRP is used only for small per-transaction fee burns and account reserves on the ledger.
reason: Ripple Labs receives preliminary MiCA license in Luxembourg, enabling services across EEA and positioning as a major compliant competitor.

The move signals Meta's push into prediction markets and adjacent digital finance, potentially broadening how it monetizes engagement and data across its ecosystem. Some analysts already assumed revenue near $343.5 billion by 2029 and thinner margins, so investors should weigh how Arena and heavier AI capital expenditure might either challenge or reinforce that more cautious view.

brief_text: Upstart Holdings renewed its forward-flow agreement with Neuberger Specialty Finance, enabling funds managed by Neuberger to purchase up to US$600,000,000 of consumer loans. title: QuantRate upgrades global trading infrastructure for AI trading bots
brief_text: Fintech platform QuantRate announced a major upgrade to its global trading access infrastructure, designed to improve automated trading execution efficiency and enhance multi-asset quantitative strategy performance. The upgrade expands global trading connectivity, allowing AI trading bots to access more international liquidity markets while maintaining stable execution in high-volatility conditions. It leverages a distributed computing architecture to optimize trade routing, reduce latency, and improve order execution accuracy. The system also introduces advanced risk management features, including volatility forecasting models, dynamic stop-loss mechanisms, and capital allocation optimization algorithms. QuantRate stated that the upgrade enables retail investors to access AI-driven intelligent trading systems more efficiently, supporting growing demand for automated trading tools in forex, cryptocurrency, and CFD markets.
reason: QuantRate announced a major upgrade to its global trading infrastructure, improving AI trading bot execution and risk management.

title: Cantor-backed bitcoin SPAC allows investors to reduce commitments amid crypto slide
brief_text: Cantor Equity Partners I, the special-purpose acquisition company sponsored by Cantor Fitzgerald, is allowing large investors who had pledged to invest in its planned merger with bitcoin treasury platform BSTR Holdings to reduce their commitments to about a third of the initial amount, Bloomberg News reported, citing a document it reviewed. The move comes as bitcoin has slid 44% over the past year, cutting the value of the 30,021 bitcoin that were expected to be on the combined company's balance sheet from roughly $3.58 billion at the time of the deal announcement last July to approximately $1.80 billion. The deal originally anticipated $1.5 billion in private investment in public equity financings and about $200 million from the SPAC. Earlier this week, the SPAC postponed a shareholder vote on the combination from Friday to Thursday, July 2, and said it continues to solicit proxies with the same proposed resolutions.
reason: BSTR Holdings' planned merger with the SPAC is jeopardized as investors cut commitments and the vote is postponed.

title: Salesforce disables Klue integration after data breach exposes customer data
brief_text: Salesforce has disabled the Klue Battlecards integration across its platform after a data breach exposed customer data. The company says the root vulnerability was in Klue's legacy integration, not in Salesforce's core systems, but attackers used stolen OAuth tokens to pull records through the Salesforce API. The incident affected multiple enterprise customers, including security-focused clients, and has intensified scrutiny on third-party integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem. The breach comes as Salesforce's stock trades at $150.19, down 40.8% year to date, and investors are reassessing risk alongside financial performance. The focus now is on how Salesforce manages third-party risk, incident response, and communication, with potential implications for AppExchange policies and API security controls.
reason: Klue's legacy integration had a root vulnerability that led to a data breach, and Salesforce disabled the integration, damaging Klue's reputation and product trust.

title: High Roller Technologies secures NFA introducing broker license for U.S. prediction markets launch
brief_text: High Roller Technologies has received approval from the National Futures Association to register its subsidiary ROLR US LLC as a guaranteed introducing broker, clearing a key regulatory hurdle for its planned U.S. prediction markets platform. The registration allows ROLR US LLC to operate under a guarantee agreement with OG Markets US, doing business as Crypto.com FCM, which will carry customer accounts and provide transaction processing, custody, and regulatory infrastructure. Eligible ROLR customers are expected to gain access to event contracts offered by Crypto.com | Derivatives North America across sports, finance, entertainment, and other real-world events, with CDNA serving as the exclusive provider of prediction contracts through High Roller's U.S. platform for the initial 24 months. High Roller anticipates participating economically through a revenue-sharing arrangement tied to customer activity, and the company is now focused on final integration, testing, and operational elements ahead of its target launch date.

title: Polymarket annualized revenue surpasses $1 billion after U.S. exchange launch
brief_text: Prediction market platform Polymarket's annualized revenue has surpassed $1 billion, the company told CNBC on Friday. The milestone comes six weeks after Polymarket lifted the waitlist for its U.S. exchange, which operates separately from its international decentralized finance platform. Daily volume on the U.S. platform rose from around $50 million in mid-May to more than $200 million on June 20, according to Dune Analytics, while weekly trading volume on the international platform hit all-time highs amid the FIFA World Cup. The U.S. exchange launched in December after Polymarket was barred from operating in the country in 2022 for failing to register with regulators; the CFTC and Department of Justice later dropped their investigations without charges, and the platform now operates as a CFTC-regulated exchange. The U.S. platform remains mobile-only, with desktop users directed to scan a QR code to download the app.
reason: Annualized revenue surpassed $1B, driven by strong user growth and trading volume after U.S. exchange launch.

title: Tata Electronics tightens internal controls after data breach
brief_text: Tata Electronics, a key Indian supplier to Apple, has restricted internal access to sensitive systems and hired a global consultant for a forensic audit after a ransomware group leaked over 200,000 files on the dark web, a Tata source and two industry officials said. The company reported the incident to the Indian government and its clients, and has hardened access to sensitive internal tools such as purchase order systems, allowing remote access only to select employees. The leaked data includes purported component design papers from Apple and Tesla, as well as at least 16 files from TSMC and 23 from Qualcomm, though Reuters could not verify the authenticity. Apple's security team is working closely with Tata on near- and long-term measures following the breach, which is a setback for Apple's supply chain diversification efforts in India.
reason: Tata Electronics suffered a ransomware data breach, leading to tightened internal controls and forensic audit.

title: Meta appoints CRED founder Kunal Shah as global head of WhatsApp
brief_text: Meta Platforms has appointed CRED founder Kunal Shah as global head of WhatsApp, following a US$900 million investment in the Indian fintech firm. The move signals a push to expand WhatsApp beyond messaging into digital payments and commerce, with a focus on emerging markets such as India. Shah, who has operated inside India's payments and consumer credit ecosystem, replaces Will Cathcart, who is moving into a product development role elsewhere in Meta. The appointment points to a leadership bench more closely aligned with financial services, merchant tools, and potentially subscription or fee-based products inside WhatsApp.
reason: CRED founder Kunal Shah's appointment may enhance CRED's partnership prospects with Meta, though not directly mentioned.

title: Visa and Mintoak partner to expand merchant SaaS offerings across Asia Pacific
brief_text: Visa and Mintoak have partnered to provide merchant SaaS capabilities to acquirers across the Asia Pacific region. The collaboration combines Mintoak's cloud-native, API-led platform with Visa's global payments network and data expertise, enabling banks and financial institutions to shift from transaction-led models to platform-led digital experiences. Acquirers can offer merchants a unified interface integrating omnichannel payment acceptance with value-added services like reporting, business insights, and engagement tools. The modular, scalable technology is designed for rapid deployment, helping financial institutions modernize infrastructure while retaining direct control over merchant relationships. The initiative aims to accelerate digitization of small and medium-sized businesses by streamlining onboarding and increasing payment acceptance density, while data-driven insights and efficient servicing seek to reduce margin pressure, increase merchant lifetime value, and drive sustainable growth.
reason: Mintoak's partnership with Visa provides a major distribution channel for its merchant SaaS platform across Asia Pacific.

title: Husher Launches Instant Crypto Swap Platform With 2-Second Settlement and No-KYC Access
brief_text: Husher, a non-custodial crypto exchange, announced benchmark results showing it completed a roughly $1,000 SOL swap in 2 seconds with a 0.34% all-in fee, outperforming competitors like ChangeNOW, FixedFloat, and SimpleSwap. title: XTransfer and BBVA sign MOU to deepen cross-border payments across Latin America, Europe, and Hong Kong
brief_text: XTransfer has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with BBVA to deepen cross-border payment infrastructure spanning Latin America, Europe, and Hong Kong SAR. The MOU was signed by XTransfer Founder and CEO Bill Deng and BBVA Global Sector Co-Head of TMT Ksenia Nekrasova during Money20/20 Europe 2026 in Amsterdam. The partnership will explore APIs, digital platforms, collection solutions, and virtual accounts to support automated, real-time FX conversion and transaction processing for SMEs. XTransfer also showcased its Latin America strategy at Expo Eléctrica International 2026 in Mexico City, where it highlighted support for local Mexican peso collections and one-account global payments covering over 200 countries and regions. The company now serves more than 890,000 SMEs globally and is expanding partnerships with local banks across Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.

brief_text: QuantRate has launched a free AI-powered crypto trading bot aimed at bringing institutional-grade automated trading to retail traders, as Bitcoin consolidates near the $60,000 level. title: Cboe Launches Cboe Predicts Binary Options on Mini S&P 500 Index
brief_text: Cboe Global Markets has launched Cboe Predicts, a new regulated prediction markets suite offering binary options tied to the Mini S&P 500 Index. The yes-or-no payoff structure simplifies decision-making while operating under the same regulatory framework and Options Clearing Corporation clearing as other U.S. listed options. The launch expands Cboe's existing index options franchise into event-based contracts, though it remains to be seen how much trading volume the new suite will attract.

title: Digital payments enter second revolution as infrastructure becomes strategic product
brief_text: The digital payments industry is undergoing a second revolution, moving beyond replacing cash to rebuilding infrastructure that makes payments invisible and settlement speed a competitive feature. McKinsey reports the industry processed 3.4 trillion transactions generating $2.4 trillion in revenue in 2023, with real-time payments in the EU projected to grow from three billion to nearly 30 billion transactions by 2028. KuCoin Pay expanded its payment network into Argentina and Peru, integrating with local QR systems like Transferencias 3.0, Yape, and Plin, while Mastercard acquired a stablecoin-focused firm for up to $1.8 billion and secured a New York BitLicense. Experts note that AI agents are becoming economic actors, requiring programmable, always-on settlement infrastructure with verified digital identities and auditable records, as agent-to-agent commerce renders traditional human-centric rails obsolete. Businesses treating payments as a strategic product are gaining structural advantages over those viewing it as a back-end utility, with settlement speed and multi-rail interoperability defining competitive divides.
reason: KuCoin Pay expanded its payment network into Argentina and Peru, integrating with local QR systems, increasing its user base and transaction volume.

title: MUFG and JCB Form Comprehensive Partnership in Southeast Asia to Strengthen Wealth Management and Payments
brief_text: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group announced on the 6th that it has signed a memorandum of understanding with major credit card company JCB for a strategic comprehensive partnership in ASEAN. Leveraging both companies' customer bases and financial and payment networks, they aim to expand their business in the region by strengthening services for wealthy individuals. As a key pillar of the partnership, they will collaborate with MUFG Bank's partner banks, such as Thailand's Bank of Ayudhya and Indonesia's Bank Danamon, to combine JCB's international payment network and merchant base, offering services that integrate finance and payments. As a first initiative this fiscal year, they plan to issue JCB's highest-tier overseas card in Indonesia. They will also explore combining the payment functions of JCB with digital financial businesses in which MUFG has invested, to enhance cross-border and mobile payment capabilities.
