brief_text: ZEN.COM has launched Mastercard Click to Pay across its platform, bringing tokenised one-click checkout to its 1.5 million users in 33 markets. The rollout covers the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Singapore, and allows consumers to complete online purchases without re-entering card details once enrolled. The feature is part of ZEN.COM's broader financial ecosystem that includes multi-currency accounts, foreign exchange, cashback, and purchase protection. Chief Growth Officer Łukasz Neska said the move reflects consumer demand for simpler, almost invisible payment experiences. The integration replaces card details with secure tokens, reducing fraud risk while preserving convenience and cardholder benefits.
reason: ZEN.COM launches Mastercard Click to Pay, a new product feature enhancing its payment platform.

title: Phemex July Proof of Reserves shows 127.77% average ratio across BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL
brief_text: Phemex has released its July 2026 Proof of Reserves update, confirming that user liabilities remain fully backed across all covered currencies. The report recorded a 127.77% average reserve ratio across BTC, ETH, USDT and SOL, with each currency remaining above the 100% threshold. Individual ratios were 112.24% for BTC, 149.50% for ETH, 104.81% for USDT, and 144.54% for SOL. The exchange uses Merkle tree-based verification, allowing users to confirm their balances are included while keeping account details private. CEO Federico Variola stated that reserve transparency is part of the user experience and reflects the standard users should expect every month.
reason: Phemex released its July 2026 Proof of Reserves showing 127.77% average ratio, demonstrating financial health and transparency.

title: Affirm partners with Bed Bath & Beyond to offer buy now, pay later
brief_text: Affirm Holdings has partnered with Bed Bath & Beyond to offer its buy now, pay later solution across the retailer's brands, including Bed Bath & Beyond, Overstock and buybuy BABY. Eligible shoppers can pay in biweekly or monthly installments with no late or hidden fees. The agreement expands Affirm's presence in the home retail market, where purchases often involve higher ticket sizes. As of March 31, 2026, Affirm's active merchants were around 515,000, up 43.8% year over year, and gross merchandise volume grew 35% in the third quarter of fiscal 2026.
reason: Beyond, Inc. (Overstock) is included in the partnership, benefiting from Affirm's BNPL offering.

title: Futurionex Launches Trust Center After Hacken Security Audit
brief_text: Futurionex has officially launched its Trust Center following the latest phase of a security audit conducted with Hacken. The audit focused on the platform's core security framework, including penetration tests on account security, data encryption, and compliance systems. Hacken also examined permission management and API access control to prevent unauthorized access, while Futurionex upgraded its withdrawal risk control and abnormal behavior monitoring to intercept money laundering and fraud risks. The Trust Center makes these security mechanisms publicly transparent, and the platform will continue to update assessment reports and security data as Hacken's audit progresses.
reason: Security audit completion and Trust Center launch enhance platform credibility and user trust.

title: XRP Could Surpass Bitcoin and Ethereum Combined Market Cap, Analyst Predicts
brief_text: XRP currently has a market cap of $65 billion, compared to a combined $1.4 trillion for Bitcoin and Ethereum. For XRP to surpass both, it would need to become a $20 crypto, a 20-fold increase from its current price of $1. Fintech company Ripple has spent over $3 billion on acquisitions to position XRP as the centerpiece of a global blockchain-based payment network, with institutional adoption and real-world asset tokenization seen as key catalysts. Some price predictions for XRP reach as high as $500, though a more realistic path is pushing past $10 and eventually reaching $20 within the next decade.
reason: Ripple has spent over $3 billion on acquisitions to position XRP as centerpiece of global payment network, with positive analyst predictions.

title: NexQloud Technologies Assessed Awardable for U.S. Department of Defense Work
brief_text: NexQloud Technologies has been assessed as Awardable by the U.S. Department of Defense's Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office for Qlarity, the cost intelligence layer of its distributed cloud platform. The designation places NexQloud among just 154 organizations in the CDAO's acquisition ecosystem, a program that has driven over $3.4 billion in Department of Defense awards. Qlarity uses deep learning and generative AI to analyze cloud spend across multiple providers, surfacing 20 to 30 percent in cost avoidance on the first pass in commercial deployments. The recognition follows NexQloud's recent SOC 2 Type 2 attestation and progress toward CMMC Level 2, with FedRAMP Moderate authorization next on its roadmap. The Awardable status confirms the solution met competitive evaluation standards, allowing Department of Defense program offices to award directly without a new competition.
reason: NexQloud's Qlarity platform assessed as Awardable by DoD CDAO, enabling direct awards without new competition.

title: American Express Expands Membership Rewards Points Redemption with Apple Pay
brief_text: American Express has launched a new feature allowing eligible U.S. Card Members to redeem Membership Rewards points directly within the Apple Pay checkout experience online and in apps. The Use Pay with Points with Apple Pay option lets Card Members apply points to cover all or part of a purchase without leaving the checkout flow. The move follows the recent announcement that Fanatics will become a Membership Rewards transfer partner within the next year, enabling point transfers into FanCash for apparel, collectibles, and experiences. American Express says the expansion reflects its commitment to offering redemption opportunities at more brands and businesses that matter to Card Members.
reason: Fanatics will become a Membership Rewards transfer partner, potentially driving customer engagement and sales.

brief_text: Uklon, Ukraine's leading ride-hailing service and part of Kyivstar's digital ecosystem, has integrated the Visa Acceptance Platform into its application. The integration builds on Uklon's transformation into a comprehensive urban mobility and digital services ecosystem spanning ride-hailing, delivery, advertising, and intercity travel.

title: GIX Appoints Sara Dillon as Chief Technology Officer
brief_text: GIX, one of only ten registered stock exchange operators in the U.S., has appointed Sara Dillon as Chief Technology Officer. Dillon will lead the company's core enterprise technology strategy, overseeing the architecture, development, and scaling of its trading infrastructure and product roadmap. She most recently served as Executive Director and Global Head of Trading Surveillance Technology at J.P. Morgan, and previously spent over a decade at the New York Stock Exchange in senior leadership roles including Managing Director of Trading Systems. GIX is preparing to launch its national securities exchange in the first quarter of 2027, with a platform designed to support tokenized securities, environmental markets, and other real-world assets.
reason: Appointment of experienced CTO to lead technology strategy for upcoming exchange launch

title: Obook Holdings' OwlTing Group partners with Credible Finance for cross-border payments
brief_text: Obook Holdings' OwlTing Group has signed a cross-border payment partnership with U.S. payment orchestration platform Credible Finance. The companies will open new payment corridors for each other's customers, starting with China and with plans to explore a corridor into India. reason: Partnership opens new payment corridors for Credible Finance's customers, increasing platform usage and demand.

title: XRP Could Turn $10,000 Into $48,000 in 5 Years If It Hits $5
brief_text: XRP trades near $1.04 as of June 26, down 44% year to date, but a bull scenario could see it reach $5 within five years, turning a $10,000 investment into about $48,000. The optimistic outlook hinges on growing adoption of Ripple Payments and its on-demand liquidity feature, which reported over $35 billion in volume in Q1 2026, a 41% year-over-year increase. Regulatory clarity has improved after the SEC lawsuit ended in August 2025 with a $125 million fine and a ruling that XRP is not an unregistered security, and spot XRP ETFs approved in November 2025 have attracted $723 million in net inflows. More conservative projections suggest XRP could trade at $1.75, yielding $16,800 on a $10,000 investment, while a bear case sees it falling to $0.50, reducing the investment to $4,800.
reason: Ripple's payment volume growth and regulatory clarity boost its business prospects.

title: Ford Motor Company and Hueler Help Employees Receive a Paycheck for Life
brief_text: Ford Motor Company employees and 401(k) participants in the U.S. now have the option to convert a portion of their Ford 401(k) into a lifetime annuity through Hueler's Income Solutions platform. Launched in January, the new option allows participants to compare annuity quotes from multiple insurance providers, model lifetime income payments in real-time, and personalize features to fit their needs. The partnership gives Ford employees the power to choose how much of their savings to use, with no minimum amount required. An annuity provides monthly payments guaranteed for life or a set number of years, and can be structured to provide continued income to a survivor.
reason: Hueler's Income Solutions platform is adopted by Ford, expanding its client base and revenue.

brief_text: In the XRP community, the view has recently been gaining strength that the token has finally been left on the sidelines of the market. title: Principal Expands Retirement Income Suite with New Lifetime Income Options
brief_text: Principal Financial Group is expanding its Principal income suite with new offerings designed to help Americans turn retirement savings into dependable income. The new savings vehicles, which can generate lifetime income, will be available within employer defined contribution investment lineups and include the Principal LifeTime Income Builder Index collective investment trusts target date funds. The expansion also adds third-party retirement income target date fund series through new strategic partnerships with TIAA/Nuveen and Income America 5forLife. The Principal LifeTime Income Builder Index is a qualified default investment alternative-eligible option with a growth-oriented, passively invested target date fund portfolio that begins allocating to a fixed indexed annuity about age 47 and automatically transitions to distributing 6% income at around age 65. The move responds to plan sponsors seeking ways to help employees build assets and confidently access them in retirement, as fewer workers have traditional pensions and market uncertainty makes converting savings into steady income challenging.

The companies plan to expand the partnership with subcontractor collaboration and contractor-to-contractor payments.
reason: Launches embedded payments platform, enhancing product offering and customer experience.

title: VanEck's Matthew Sigel Predicts Bitcoin Could Soar to $2.9 Million by 2050
brief_text: VanEck's head of digital assets research, Matthew Sigel, has issued a series of bullish Bitcoin price predictions, including a near-term target of $160,000, a medium-term forecast of $1 million, and a long-term projection of $2.9 million by 2050. Sigel's $160,000 call is based on Bitcoin's valuation multiple relative to gold recovering to 35, while the $1 million target hinges on expanding user adoption as younger generations invest. The $2.9 million forecast, published in a January VanEck analysis, assumes Bitcoin will become the settlement currency for 5% to 10% of global trade and a reserve asset comprising 2.5% of central bank balance sheets, growing at a 15% compound annual rate. Bitcoin currently trades around $60,000, down from its October 2025 all-time high of $126,000, and its fixed supply of 21 million coins underpins the bull case. However, the $1 million and $2.9 million targets would imply market caps approaching or exceeding the estimated $28 trillion value of all gold, a comparison the article's author views as highly speculative given Bitcoin's limited real-world utility compared to the precious metal.
reason: VanEck's head of research issues bullish Bitcoin price predictions, potentially boosting firm's crypto-related products and reputation.

title: NOTO partners with Equifax UK to launch real-time AML compliance solution
brief_text: NOTO has launched a strategic partnership with Equifax UK to enable the launch of Automatic Watchlist Monitoring, a new Anti-Money Laundering solution. The alliance leverages NOTO's real-time screening engine, NOTO 360, to deliver sub-100ms response times with no transaction volume limits, screening against global sanctions, politically exposed persons, and adverse media lists. The solution addresses the UK's evolving regulatory requirements, including the Financial Conduct Authority's Finalised Guidance FG25/3 and strengthened expectations from the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation. It provides configurable thresholds, 360-degree coverage across the customer journey, and a complete audit trail for due diligence. The service is integrated via a REST API and uses Equifax proprietary data sources to help clients manage compliance risk efficiently.
reason: NOTO launches a strategic partnership with Equifax UK for its AML solution, driving adoption and revenue.

title: Solulu Tech Expands Stablecoin Infrastructure for Cross-Border Payments and Multi-Currency Settlement
brief_text: Solulu Tech announced the continued expansion of its global stablecoin infrastructure to support compliant cross-border payments and multi-currency settlement. The U.S.-based company is developing a platform that connects regulated stablecoins across multiple blockchain networks with traditional financial systems, focusing on issuance connectivity, merchant payments, fiat on-ramps and off-ramps, and multi-jurisdictional settlement. Founder Shaun Muhammad stated that the next stage of industry growth depends on building infrastructure that enables stablecoins to operate efficiently within global commerce. Solulu Tech’s long-term strategy supports a multi-stablecoin ecosystem, anticipating a future with numerous regulated stablecoins from banks, payment institutions, and sovereign jurisdictions. The company is also investing in interoperability, compliance automation, and institutional settlement efficiency.
reason: Solulu Tech is expanding its stablecoin infrastructure for cross-border payments and multi-currency settlement, a positive technology development.

title: LBank Launches LBank Card with 100,000 USDT Rewards Pool
brief_text: LBank has officially launched the LBank Card, introducing a promotion where users who activate the card and complete a first eligible purchase can share a 100,000 USDT futures bonus pool and earn up to 100% flexible savings APR boost vouchers. New users who activate the card and make a first transaction of at least 50 USDT receive a 20 USDT futures bonus, while pre-registered users who complete activation and a qualifying purchase before July 1, 2026, get a doubled reward of 40 USDT. The campaign runs until July 25, 2026. The card allows spending directly from spot account balances, is accepted at millions of Visa merchants worldwide, supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, and carries zero issuance, monthly maintenance, or top-up fees.
reason: LBank launches its own card product, a new technology/service offering.

title: PrivacyHawk Launches Enterprise Service to Reduce Shadow Digital Footprint and Third-Party Breach Risk
brief_text: PrivacyHawk announced the general availability of PrivacyHawk Enterprise, a first-of-its-kind solution that identifies and eliminates shadow IT accounts, abandoned SaaS subscriptions, and forgotten third-party services that expose organizations to breach risk. The service provides security teams full visibility into employees' external digital footprints, automates data deletion across thousands of third-party services, and reduces exposure that traditional security tools miss. CEO Aaron Mendes noted that organizations with hundreds or thousands of employees can have millions of shadow IT accounts, each a potential data exposure. PrivacyHawk has already helped millions of consumers reduce their digital footprint and is now bringing the same automated capability to businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies. Organizations can run a free scan at e.privacyhawk.com.
reason: Launches new enterprise service to reduce shadow IT and third-party breach risk.

title: Alkami Integrates FDX API With Yodlee for Financial Data Sharing
brief_text: Alkami Technology announced an integration with Yodlee to shift data sharing services to the Financial Data Exchange application programming interface. The company said the transition will improve performance and reduce login disruptions for users accessing third-party financial applications, supporting both security and user experience. The FDX API integration is built into Alkami's digital banking platform and enables credential-free, consent-based authentication for sharing financial data between institutions and third-party services. Alkami expects the integration to make data sharing more efficient, reducing support inquiries and lowering infrastructure strain. The company provides a digital sales and service platform for community banks and credit unions.
reason: Yodlee is the integration partner, benefiting from Alkami's adoption of its data sharing services.

title: XRP Nears $1, Down 70% From High, as Ripple Builds Use Cases
brief_text: XRP is trading near $1, down roughly 70% from its 52-week high of $3.65 reached last summer. The cryptocurrency has fallen 40% year-to-date and is in what the author describes as free fall, though it last traded at these levels in late 2024 before a rally past $3. title: Toobit Introduces Zero Fees for Spot Trading
brief_text: Toobit has announced zero-fee trading across selected spot pairs from June 26 through September 26, 2026. The promotion eliminates maker and taker fees that normally range from 0.0125% to 0.0750% for makers and 0.0375% to 0.1000% for takers depending on VIP level. For an active trader moving a monthly volume of $1,000,000, standard taker fees could typically cost between $375 and $1,000, which traders now retain as capital. The move targets high-frequency traders, arbitrageurs, and those who frequently rebalance portfolios, allowing them to capture value from smaller price movements.
reason: Toobit eliminates spot trading fees, directly reducing user costs and attracting traders.

title: Most Americans Lack a 401(k) Withdrawal Strategy, Survey Finds
brief_text: A new survey from the TIAA Institute and Nuveen finds that most Americans have not given much thought to a 401(k) withdrawal strategy, with only 22% saying they considered it a lot. Nearly all respondents wanted more employer guidance on retirement income planning, yet even that advice may be too generic. Brendan McCarthy, head of Nuveen Retirement Investing, noted that 401(k) plans have been designed almost exclusively as savings vehicles with no built-in way to convert savings into lifetime income. The report also revealed low financial literacy, with participants correctly answering only about a third of Social Security and Medicare questions and about a quarter of long-term care and withdrawal questions. Advisors say helping clients craft a spending strategy can fill an important planning gap, especially as retirees face complex decisions on account drawdown order, Social Security, taxes, and healthcare costs over potentially 25 to 30 years in retirement.
reason: Survey shows most Americans lack a 401(k) withdrawal strategy, indicating low engagement with retirement planning, which could reduce demand for Nuveen's retirement investment products.

Users can invest with a minimum of 50 USDT through recurring purchases, enabling a dollar-cost averaging approach. title: Visa and Thredd Expand Cloud-Based Issuing Across Asia Pacific
brief_text: Visa is expanding its role in Asia Pacific's payments landscape through Thredd's implementation of Visa Cloud Connect across the region. The initiative enables Thredd to access VisaNet via cloud-based infrastructure, supporting faster issuing deployments for fintechs, digital banks and embedded-finance providers. This development underscores the broader shift toward cloud-based financial services in the Asia Pacific as digital payments and AI-driven commerce gain traction.
